name: Startup India Recognition
description: DPIIT recognition of startups to avail tax benefits, easier compliance, IPR fast-track, and funding access.
eligibility: Entity incorporated as Pvt Ltd/LLP/Partnership, <=10 years old, turnover <= Rs. 100 crore, working toward innovation.
benefits: Tax exemption (80-IAC/Section 56), faster patents, self-certification, government tenders, Fund of Funds.
application_steps: Apply for DPIIT recognition with details.
Self-certify and submit; get recognition number.
processing_time: Recognition typically within days of submission.
validity: Recognition valid while entity meets criteria; deregister if not.
office_locator_info: Startup India hubs; state nodal agencies.

faq.q: What is the age/turnover limit for a startup?
faq.a: Incorporated <=10 years, turnover <= Rs. 100 crore, Indian entity.

ai_summary: Startup India gives DPIIT recognition for tax, IP, and tender benefits to eligible young innovative entities.
ai_explanation: Eligible Indian startups (<=10 years, turnover <= Rs. 100 crore) self-apply for DPIIT recognition, unlocking income-tax exemptions, faster IP protection, self-certification on labour laws, and easier public procurement. Recognition is free.
